Resolves #20187

A grid with locked columns now presents one WAI-ARIA grid to assistive technology:
- **Columns are numbered grid-wide.** `Container#getAriaColumnOffset` adds the column count of the preceding regions to each cell and header button.
- **Each record is one row.** The lead region's row (start if present, else center) owns the other regions' rows for the same record through `aria-owns`, and those rows take `role="none"`. The header toolbars follow the same pattern (`Wrapper#syncAriaRows`).
- **The engine no longer reads ARIA back.** The header SortZone resolves the dragged column by `dataField`, and `Body#getRecordByRowId` reads the row's own `rowIndex`.

Evidence: L2 (unit, component and e2e, including Chromium's own accessibility tree via CDP; red-first on origin/dev) → L2 required (AC-1 to AC-4). Residual: AC-5 (a real screen-reader read on the deployed showcase), Residual-Owner: #20188, the sibling grid ARIA ticket, which needs the same read.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the baseline `pr-body` and `substrate-size` checks run in CI. Change class: restoration (`fix`).

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `unit/grid/AriaRegions.spec.mjs` checks cells and headers 1–5 across start, center and end, plus the offsets 0/2/4. `component/grid/HeaderMenuShape.spec.mjs` checks headers 1–5 |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the grid DnD e2e (`LockedDnDDuplication`, `ColumnOverdragScroll`) and the unit suite. SortZone reads `dataField` (`SortZone.mjs` `createDragProxy` / `onDragStart`), and a `src/` grep finds no ARIA reads left (Test Evidence) |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `e2e/grid/IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs`, "assistive technology reads one row per record across the locked regions" (CDP `Accessibility.getFullAXTree`: 1 header row of 8 column headers plus 8 rows of 8 cells) |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `AriaRegions.spec.mjs` checks that a grid with one region keeps plain rows (no owner, no ownership) |
| AC-5 | Post-merge: see Post-Merge Validation |

## Deltas from ticket
- The toolbar and menu-trigger placement (the old Fix item 4) moved to #20188. It affects every grid and restructures the header element.
- `Body#syncAriaRowOwns`: the start body renders before its siblings build their pools, and an unchanged lead row skips its next render. So each sibling re-syncs the lead rows' `aria-owns` after its own pass. The first unit run caught the missing ownership.
- `Body#getRecordByRowId` returns `null` for a hidden pool row (`rowIndex` -1); before, it read that row's stale `aria-rowindex`.
- `HeaderMenuShape.spec.mjs` pinned the old behavior (`colindex: ['1','2','1','2','1']`, three ARIA rows per record). It now expects 1–5 and counts rendered rows by `.neo-grid-row[data-record-id]`. The `RowCellIdMigration.spec.mjs` stubs gained the three new body/container members.
- `HeaderCellRectSync` and `HeaderResizeRectSync` (e2e) read a region body's first `[role="row"]`, which is now `null` outside the lead region. CI caught it on `9f6d6b2`. They now pick `.neo-grid-row[data-record-id]`, and pass locally: 1/1, and 6/6 with a seat-own Bridge port.

## Test Evidence
- **Red-first on origin/dev `4f286ab`.** The new unit spec: 5 of 6 fail; the passing one is the single-region guard. The new e2e test reads 27 accessibility rows (3 per record plus 3 header rows) where 9 are expected.
- **Head runs.** Full unit suite: 5602 passed, 2 skipped. One `e2e/browserLifecycleReporter` case failed only while my parallel e2e run shared its output file; alone it passes 11/11. Grid and draggable units: 416 passed (410 on base plus the 6 new). Grid components: 67 passed, including `HeaderMenuShape` 8/8.
- **`src/` grep.** `aria-colindex` and `aria-rowindex` are only written now; the one comparison left (`Wrapper.mjs:150`) guards a write.

- [ ] AC-5: a VoiceOver + Safari or NVDA read on the deployed issues showcase announces the right column header and position for a locked-start, a center and a locked-end cell.
- [ ] The data-grid post (#20186) drops its locked-column limits line once this ships.

- `f002cdc`: the rect-sync e2e specs select rows by record, not by role.

# PR Review Summary

### 🪜 Strategic-Fit Decision

Per §9 Strategic-Fit Step-Back:
- **Decision**: Approve
- **Rationale**: The PR resolves a real WAI-ARIA 1.2 structural defect (`#20187`) introduced when multi-body locked columns (`#9486`) split the grid into up to three region bodies and toolbars while leaving `aria-colindex` region-local and exposing three `role="row"` elements per record. Decoupling `SortZone` and `Body#getRecordByRowId` from reading ARIA attributes back from VDOM, offsetting `aria-colindex` across regions via `Container#getAriaColumnOffset`, and unifying sibling rows under the lead region's row via `aria-owns` (`role="none"` on non-lead rows/toolbars) is the clean, minimal, merge-safe architecture.

**Peer-Review Opening:** 🖖 Clean and principled fix for `#20187`. Breaking the engine's read-back dependency on `aria-colindex` / `aria-rowindex` (`SortZone` resolving by `dataField` and `Body#getRecordByRowId` reading `rowIndex`) removes the root cause that kept `aria-colindex` toolbar-local, and the `aria-owns` lead-region ownership model across both `Body` and `header.Wrapper` is verified directly against Chromium's accessibility tree via CDP `Accessibility.getFullAXTree`.

---

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** Ticket `neomjs/neo#20187` (`Design authority:` WAI-ARIA 1.2 `aria-colindex` / `aria-rowindex` / `row` ownership rules + `Container.mjs:1717` global `aria-colcount`), changed-file list (`12` files), current `dev` source of `src/draggable/grid/header/toolbar/SortZone.mjs`, `src/grid/Body.mjs`, `src/grid/Container.mjs`, `src/grid/Row.mjs`, `src/grid/header/Toolbar.mjs`, and `src/grid/header/Wrapper.mjs`, plus `memory-mining` sweep (`c666e37c`, `09be33dc`, `473e0c5f`).
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** `SortZone` and `Body#getRecordByRowId` must stop reading ARIA attributes as layout/record state; `Container` must provide a region column-offset helper (`0` for `start`, `lockedStartColumns.length` for `center`, `lockedStartColumns.length + centerColumns.length` for `end`) consumed by `Row` and `header.Toolbar`/`Wrapper`; the first active region (`start` if present, else `center`) must own sibling regions' rows/toolbars via `aria-owns` while sibling rows/toolbars take `role="none"` with no row-level ARIA indices. It must not hardcode region presence (`start` may be absent while `end` is present) and must cover multi-region, runtime-unlocked, single-region, and CDP accessibility-tree behavior in isolated unit/e2e specs.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches the expected shape. `Container#getAriaColumnOffset` computes the region offset from `lockedStartColumns` and `centerColumns`; `Body#isAriaLeadRegion`, `Body#getAriaRowOwns`, and `Body#syncAriaRowOwns` coordinate row ownership even when sibling pools build after the lead body's pass; `Wrapper#syncAriaRows` mirrors the ownership contract for header toolbars; `AriaRegions.spec.mjs` and `IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs` (`Accessibility.getFullAXTree`) verify both VDOM and browser AXTree projection.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with `§verify_before_assert` and `§friction_to_gold`: the defect was discovered by empirically inspecting the production DOM while verifying blog claims (`#20184` / `#20186`), traced to the read-back coupling in `SortZone`, and fixed at the root rather than patched in prose.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

- **Challenge**: In `src/grid/Body.mjs` (`getAriaRowOwns`), each lead row resolves its sibling row IDs via modulo indexing (`body.items[rowIndex % body.items.length].id`). This relies on the Fixed-DOM-Order invariant (`createViewData` mapping `rowIndex` to `rowIndex % poolSize`) and on all active region bodies converging to the same `items.length` (`rowPoolSize`) once `createRowPool()` has run on each body. I traced what happens when a column's `locked` state mutates at runtime (`Container#onColumnLockChange`): `toolbar.passSizeToBody()` calls `body.refreshColumns(true)` (`createViewData(false, true)`) on every present region body, and each non-lead body's `createViewData` invokes `(gridContainer.bodyStart || gridContainer.body)?.syncAriaRowOwns(silent)`, so lead-row `role`, `aria-colindex`, and `aria-owns` re-converge across region creation, destruction, and re-homing. If a future per-region buffer customization ever allowed two bodies in the same grid to hold different `rowPoolSize` values, `rowIndex % body.items.length` would still address the sibling slot rendering `rowIndex` as long as `rowIndex` lies within both bodies' `mountedRows` window.
